target: advance reads the status BEFORE taking the lock and never re-applies the gated-status check to the value it re-reads after — so a shelve landing in that window is silently reversed
cmd: bash "$FIXTURES/tracker-gates/mkspec.sh" specs 924 building; if TRACKER_TEST_PRELOCK_HOOK="TRACKER_FORCE_LIVE=1 FACTORY_SPECS_DIR=$PWD/specs bash $PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh shelve $PWD/specs/924-t.md racer reason" FACTORY_SPECS_DIR=$PWD/specs bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" advance specs/924-t.md built >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo ADVANCED; else echo "REFUSED:$?"; fi; echo "status=$(grep '^status:' specs/924-t.md | head -1)"
_note: TRACKER_FORCE_LIVE belongs to the HOOK's shelve (it targets a live 'building' spec), never to the advance under test — on the advance it is the documented override and would bypass the very guard this case exists to exercise. An earlier version had it on both.
